prior_year_events.impact_description: RITC recorded the assets and liabilities transferred at fair value on the date the RITC agreement was effective; members' balances including funds in syndicate were transferred and closing losses for 2019 were discharged to Syndicate 4000 in June 2022. The RITC transaction had no impact on the Syndicate's profit or net assets at the time it was recorded.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was GBP 786.4m. During 2024 there was a small net prior-year release of GBP 3.3m on gross claims provisions, driven by favourable claims development overall, although the year also saw increased net catastrophe losses which reduced the scale of prior-year releases compared to the prior year. The release is recorded in the technical provisions reconciliation as a gross reduction in prior year provisions of GBP 3.337m.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation line 'Change in estimates of prior year provisions' (gross = (3,337)k). The claims development triangle is present and consistent with a small net favourable movement; an RITC of Syndicate 3334 in 2022 is noted in the accounts and was recorded at fair value but reportedly had no impact on profit or net assets when recorded. No line-of-business specific prior-year movements were quantified in the notes, so LOB-level PYD is not available.
